body.message:
Hello,
I recently reviewed your Google Maps business listing and noticed that some customer-uploaded images are attached to negative reviews. These images can affect potential customers’ trust and may impact your business reputation, even if your service quality is excellent.
I specialize in assisting businesses with the removal of image reviews that violate Google Maps policies.
Most removals are successfully completed within 2–3 days.
What you can expect: • No upfront payment required
• No access to your Google account
• No personal or sensitive information needed
• Payment only after the successful removal
For your reference, I have also attached a screenshot of the negative image reviews currently visible on your listing.
If you would like assistance with this, simply reply to this message and I will gladly explain the process.
Best regards.
